subject: QBR + Roadmap demo — orchestration, alternate slots, and backup presenters
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@acme-analytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme QBR + roadmap demo — scheduling

Hi Jonas / Laura,

Hope you’re both well — we’re finalizing the agenda for our May renewal QBR with the product/engineering and procurement teams and would like a 45–60 minute roadmap demo focused on: performance improvements, cost/throughput tradeoffs, and the dedicated/private deployment pitch.

Can you propose 2–3 slots next week that would work for your team? Our core group: myself, Olivia Reed (eng sponsor), and one procurement rep (copied). We’re US PST-EDT distributed.

Also: can you include a backup presenter in case the account lead needs to be pulled into exec meetings? We’ll need the slide deck and an <~10 min> exec summary at the top.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Director of Platform Partnerships, Acme Analytics
samir@acme-analytics.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme QBR + roadmap demo — scheduling

Samir — thanks for the note. We can absolutely do this. Proposed slots (all in PDT):

- Tue 2027-05-25 10:00–11:00 (PDT) — 1h deep demo + 10min exec wrap
- Wed 2027-05-26 13:00–14:00 (PDT) — later afternoon for east-coast folks
- Thu 2027-05-27 08:30–09:30 (PDT) — earlier slot if leadership prefers mornings

Backup presenter: Rishi Malhotra (cc’d to this thread) can run the demo if I’m pulled into an exec call. He’ll cover the quantization/throughput recommendations and dedicated capacity play.

I have attached a draft agenda (Acme-QBR-agenda.pdf) and an initial deck placeholder (Roadmap-demo-v1.pptx). I’ll update the top-level exec summary to a single slide once you confirm the audience.

Let me know which slot you prefer and any stakeholders we should add.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
From: Olivia Reed <olivia@acme-analytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@acme-analytics.com>, procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Acme QBR + roadmap demo — scheduling

On Fri, May 22, 2027 at 10:05 AM Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Proposed slots (all in PDT):
> - Tue 2027-05-25 10:00–11:00 (PDT)
> - Wed 2027-05-26 13:00–14:00 (PDT)
> - Thu 2027-05-27 08:30–09:30 (PDT)

Jonas / Samir — thanks. Quick update: our VP of eng was just pulled into an emergency planning session on Tue and Wed morning, so Tue 10:00 is no longer a go for us. Thu morning looks promising but can you do a slightly earlier slot for east coast attendance? 08:00–09:00 PDT (11:00–12:00 EDT) would be ideal for our procurement lead to step out briefly and still join the first 30 minutes.

Also can you cc your CS lead for renewal talking points and the SOW discussion? Procurement will want the SOW snapshot and any standard terms in advance.

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Reed
Senior Engineering Sponsor, Acme Analytics
olivia@acme-analytics.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Reed <olivia@acme-analytics.com>, Samir Patel <samir@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme QBR + roadmap demo — scheduling

Olivia / Samir — we can do Thu 2027-05-27 08:00–09:00 PDT (11:00–12:00 EDT). Agenda plan: 5–7 minute exec summary, 35 minute demo (perf + cost tradeoffs, dedicated/private use cases), 10–15 minute commercial/SOW Q&A.

Operational notes and asks:
- Rishi will be demo host if Jonas needs to leave for an exec meeting. He’ll cover quantization/throughput settings and the recommendation matrix.
- Marissa (CS) will join for renewal posture and to walk the SOW highlights.
- Please share any compliance/security questions in advance so we can pull the right evidence (SOC2 artifacts, retention guarantees).

Attachments included: Roadmap-demo-v1.pptx (deck for the demo) and a draft SOW snapshot (SOW-draft-closed.pdf).

Calendar invite: we’ll send an invite once Samir confirms attendee list.

Laura Bennett
Renewals Lead, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Perfect — Thu 2027-05-27 08:00–09:00 PDT works for our group (Samir, Olivia, procurement). Please include your CS and SOW lead (Marissa) and Rishi as backup.

Could you send the calendar invite and a single Drive link with the final deck + the 1-slide exec summary? Procurement asked for the SOW snapshot in advance; attaching a short checklist of additional compliance items they may request (see inline).

Looking forward to it — Samir
